_comment: Progressive destruction (#72). Client presentation only: wreck pieces, cut look, debris physics and which model parts come off as their zone is worn down. The authoritative killing blow (kind, point, axis, force) comes from the snapshot; railgun overpenetration tuning lives in turret_weapons.json. Distances are metres at the bot's runtime scale unless noted; speeds m/s; times s.

debris._comment: Physics debris collides with the world only, never with bots or camera rays. max_pieces bounds live bodies per client (oldest sink away first). Bodies freeze after rest_seconds of stillness; sinking takes sink_seconds.

parts._comment: Parts lost while a bot still fights. Each model's component meshes (weapon, left/right drive) and its smaller hull panels, grouped by the face they sit on, are split into clusters. A cluster comes off each time the zone's HP fraction falls through a threshold (0 = whatever is left goes). Hull panels also come off as the core falls through core_thresholds, on the face last hit. Meshes bigger than hull_share of the bot's volume never come off, so the silhouette survives until the kill. The cluster nearest a hit seen within hit_memory seconds goes first. sever_kinds cut parts off with a glowing seam. speed/lift/spin launch detached parts (before geometry scale).

cut._comment: heat_seconds: how long cut seams glow; glow_band: width of the hot seam; tear_frequency: seam roughness per metre; soot: how blackened wreck metal is (0..1).

styles._comment: How a destroyed bot comes apart. pieces: 1 (intact wreck), 2 (split by a plane through the blow; the saw's plane is its blade) or 3..5 Voronoi shards around the blow. tear: seam roughness (m). tunnel: bore radius (m) along the blow's axis (railgun). centre_pull: 0 cuts through the blow point, 1 through the bot's centre. speed: separation speed away from the blow; lift: upward share; spin: tumble (rad/s). split_force: overkill (raw hit over the core left) at which a tunnel-only wreck also splits.

kinds._comment: Event kind of the killing blow -> style. Anything unlisted uses default.
